text: 美国劳工统计局最新数据显示，美国9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，较8月的3.4%明显反弹，为5月份以来最高水平；核心CPI同比上涨2.6%，较前值2.4%回升。对此，东方金诚研究副总监白雪表示，美国9月通胀明显反弹且涨价面明显扩散，能源冲击与核心通胀黏性形成共振，通胀回归2%目标的“最后一公里”仍不平坦。通胀反弹强化了美联储年内继续加息的必要性，但就业降温与金融条件收紧对加息节奏形成制约。预计10月按兵不动、12月再加息25个基点的概率上升。
text_en: The latest data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics show that U.S. CPI rose 3.7% year on year in September, rebounding notably from 3.4% in August and reaching the highest level since May; core CPI rose 2.6% year on year, up from the previous 2.4%. In response, Bai Xue, deputy research director at Oriental Jincheng, said that U.S. inflation rebounded significantly in September and the breadth of price increases expanded markedly, with energy shocks and core inflation stickiness forming a resonance. The "last mile" back to the 2% inflation target remains uneven. The inflation rebound strengthens the necessity for the Federal Reserve to continue raising rates within the year, but cooling employment and tighter financial conditions constrain the pace of rate hikes. The probability is rising that the Fed will stay put in October and raise rates by another 25 basis points in December.
